kredarica-mt-triglav-se: Kredarica is the mountain hut and weather station just below the summit of Triglav, the highest mountain in Slovenia at 2,864 m. The hut stands at about 2,515 m and is the usual last stop for climbers heading to the top.
kredarica-mt-triglav-e: Kredarica is the mountain hut and weather station just below the summit of Triglav, the highest mountain in Slovenia at 2,864 m. This camera looks east from the hut, which stands at about 2,515 m.
waimakariri-river-bridge-sh1: This is the bridge that carries State Highway 1 over the Waimakariri River just north of Christchurch, on New Zealand's South Island. Locals call the river the Waimak. It is the main road north out of the city, so the camera is a quick way to check the traffic.
lom-b-verdalen-leirvassbu: Leirvassbu is a mountain lodge at about 1,400 m above the Bøverdalen valley, in Lom in Norway. It sits in the middle of Jotunheimen, the country's highest mountain range, and is a base for hikers in summer and ski tourers in spring.
duffey-lake-road-cayoosh-summit-hwy-99: The Duffey Lake Road is the stretch of Highway 99 between Pemberton and Lillooet in British Columbia. Cayoosh Summit is its high point, and the camera is there for drivers checking snow and road conditions before they set off.
rochehaut-south-frahan: Rochehaut is a village high above a tight loop of the River Semois, in the Belgian Ardennes. The view from the top looks down on the hamlet of Frahan, tucked inside the bend of the river. It is a well-known viewpoint in Belgium.
oukaimeden-south-east-observatoire-trapp: Oukaïmeden is a ski resort in the High Atlas mountains of Morocco, about 75 km south of Marrakech, at around 2,600 m. The camera is named for the Oukaïmeden Observatory, home of the TRAPPIST-North telescope.
karpacz-east-dom-l-ski-karpacz: Dom Śląski is a mountain hostel on the saddle below Śnieżka, the highest peak of the Karkonosze mountains at 1,603 m, on the border between Poland and Czechia. Walkers pass it on the way up from Karpacz.
dublin-west-gpo-museum: The General Post Office on O'Connell Street is one of Dublin's best-known buildings. It was the headquarters of the 1916 Easter Rising, and it still works as a post office today, with a museum inside.
murnau: Murnau am Staffelsee is a market town in Upper Bavaria, Germany, at the edge of the Alps. On a clear day the mountains fill the horizon behind the town.
naselje-risovac-blidinje-ski-resort: Risovac is the ski area in Blidinje Nature Park, a high plateau between the Čvrsnica and Vran mountains in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
hulst: Hulst is a small fortified town in Zeelandic Flanders, in the far south-west of the Netherlands near the Belgian border. It is still ringed by its old ramparts.
galway: Galway is a harbour city on the west coast of Ireland, where the River Corrib runs into Galway Bay. This one is live video.
us-395-conway-summit: Conway Summit is the highest point on US Route 395, at about 8,140 ft (2,480 m), just north of Mono Lake in California's Eastern Sierra. Caltrans runs the camera so drivers can check for snow before they travel.
point-reyes-national-seashore: Point Reyes National Seashore is a stretch of wild coast north of San Francisco, in California. The headland is one of the foggiest and windiest places on the Pacific coast of the USA.
sequoia-kings-canyon: Sequoia and Kings Canyon are two neighbouring national parks in California's southern Sierra Nevada. They are home to the giant sequoias, including General Sherman, the largest tree on earth by volume.
coquihalla-great-bear-snowshed-hwy-5: The Great Bear Snowshed is a concrete avalanche shelter on the Coquihalla Highway (Highway 5) in British Columbia, between Hope and Merritt. This stretch is known for heavy snow in winter.
cradle-mountain-lake-saint-clair-nationa: Cradle Mountain–Lake St Clair National Park is in the highlands of Tasmania, Australia. Cradle Mountain is the start of the Overland Track, a walk of about six days through the park.
st-anton-am-arlberg-galzig: Galzig is the mountain above St. Anton am Arlberg in Tyrol, Austria, with its summit at 2,184 m. The Galzigbahn gondola runs up from the village, and in winter it is the main lift into the Ski Arlberg area from St. Anton.
hildesheim-marktplatz: The Marktplatz is the historic market square of Hildesheim in Lower Saxony, Germany. It was destroyed in the bombing of March 1945 and rebuilt in the 1980s, including the half-timbered Butchers' Guild Hall (Knochenhaueramtshaus), first built in 1529.
tretten-holmsetra-yer: Tretten is a village in Øyer, in the Gudbrandsdalen valley north of Lillehammer in Norway. Holmsetra is up in the hills east of the village, on the network of groomed cross-country ski trails that also links Hafjell, Pellestova and Hornsjøen.
kiruna-kommun-north-east-nikkaluokta: Nikkaluokta is a small Sami village at the end of the road, nearly 70 km west of Kiruna in Swedish Lapland. It is where the 19 km trail to the Kebnekaise mountain station starts, for walkers heading to Sweden's highest mountain.
bilje-nova-gorica: Bilje is a village in the lower Vipava valley, just south of Nova Gorica in western Slovenia and close to the Italian border. The camera is at the Slovenian Environment Agency's weather station there.
lopata-dolina-chocho-owska-kamera-topr: Dolina Chochołowska is the longest valley in the Polish Tatra mountains, in the Western Tatras near the Slovak border. It is best known for the purple crocuses that cover its meadows in spring. The camera belongs to TOPR, the Tatra volunteer mountain rescue service.
bogard: This Caltrans camera is at the Bogard Rest Area on State Route 44 in Lassen County, north-east of Lassen Volcanic National Park in northern California. It is there so drivers can check for snow on a quiet mountain stretch of road.
newfound-gap: Newfound Gap is the mountain pass on the road across Great Smoky Mountains National Park, on the state line between Tennessee and North Carolina, at 5,046 ft (1,538 m). The Appalachian Trail crosses the road here.
sveg-distrikt-north-bj-rnberget: Björnberget is the local ski hill about 8 km from Sveg, the main town of Härjedalen in central Sweden. It is run by the town's alpine ski club.
lanzarote-from-the-beachbar-in-costa-teg: Costa Teguise is a resort town on the east coast of Lanzarote in the Canary Islands, a short drive north of the island's capital, Arrecife. The steady trade winds make it a well-known spot for windsurfing.
public-square-watertown-ny-jake-johnson-: Public Square is the centre of downtown Watertown, in northern New York State, not far from Lake Ontario and the Thousand Islands. The area is known for heavy lake-effect snow in winter, so this is a good one to check when a storm comes through.
the-depot-restaurant-railcam-green-bay-w: The Depot is a restaurant in the old Chicago and North Western railway station on Dousman Street in Green Bay, Wisconsin, built in 1898. Trains still run past the building, which is why there is a railcam here.
nisa: Nisa is a small town in the Alto Alentejo, in the Portalegre district of Portugal. It is known for its sheep's milk cheese, Queijo de Nisa, and for red clay pottery decorated with tiny white stones. The camera is part of the MeteoAlentejo weather network.
old-central-school-grand-rapids-mn: Old Central School was built in 1895 and stands in the middle of downtown Grand Rapids, Minnesota. It stopped being a school long ago and is now a town landmark. Grand Rapids is also the birthplace of Judy Garland.
cape-cod-canal: The Cape Cod Canal cuts across the neck of Cape Cod in Massachusetts and opened in 1914. It saves ships the long trip around the outside of the Cape. The camera belongs to the Massachusetts Maritime Academy, which sits at the canal's western end in Buzzards Bay.
aus-dem-storchennest-in-leutershausen-mi: Leutershausen is a small town on the River Altmühl in Middle Franconia, Bavaria. White storks nest on its rooftops each year, and the local heritage society (Heimatverein) runs this camera at one of the nests. The nest is busiest from spring to late summer.
gosport-south-west-stokes-bay: Stokes Bay is a long shingle beach at Gosport in Hampshire, on the south coast of England. It faces the Solent, with the Isle of Wight across the water, so there is usually shipping and sailing to watch.
ocean-village-resort: Ocean Village Resort is a group of cedar cabins on MacKenzie Beach in Tofino, on the west coast of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. Tofino is often called the surf capital of Canada, and it is a popular place to watch winter storms roll in off the Pacific.
grindavik-mosaic: Grindavík is a fishing town on the Reykjanes peninsula in south-west Iceland. The town was evacuated in November 2023, and a series of volcanic eruptions began just to the north that December. The stream comes from RÚV, Iceland's national broadcaster.
muonio-lappi-finland-2: Muonio is a small municipality in Finnish Lapland, on the river that forms the border with Sweden. It sits well above the Arctic Circle, close to Pallas-Yllästunturi National Park, and is known for one of the longest snow seasons in Finland.
tas-electronics-old-forge-hardware-camer: Old Forge is a small town in the Adirondack Mountains of New York State, at the start of the Fulton Chain of Lakes. It gets a lot of snow and is well known for snowmobiling. The camera is at Old Forge Hardware, the town's landmark general store.
ljubljana-airport: Ljubljana Jože Pučnik Airport is Slovenia's main airport, at Brnik, about 25 km north-west of the capital. It sits on a plain below the Kamnik-Savinja Alps. The camera belongs to the Slovenian Environment Agency.
begbie-summit-hwy-97: Begbie Summit is on Highway 97, the Cariboo Highway, about 21 km south of 100 Mile House in British Columbia. DriveBC runs the camera so drivers can check snow and road conditions on the stretch between Clinton and 100 Mile House.
north-cascades-national-park: North Cascades National Park is in the north of Washington State, up against the Canadian border. It has more than 300 glaciers, more than any other national park in the USA outside Alaska.
daisy-lake-sea-to-sky-hwy-99: Daisy Lake is a reservoir on the Cheakamus River, beside the Sea-to-Sky Highway (Highway 99) between Squamish and Whistler in British Columbia. DriveBC runs the camera for drivers checking the road to Whistler.
portage-lake-lift-bridge-keweenaw-waterw: The Portage Lake Lift Bridge joins the towns of Houghton and Hancock in Michigan's Upper Peninsula. It was built in 1959, and its middle section lifts straight up to let boats through. It is the only road onto the northern part of the Keweenaw Peninsula. The camera belongs to Michigan Technological University.
brzegi-morskie-oko: Morskie Oko is the largest lake in the Tatra Mountains, at 1,395 m in Poland's Tatra National Park. Most visitors walk about 9 km up the road from the car park at Palenica Białczańska to reach it.
cape-horn-east-tres-puentes-puerto-willi: Puerto Williams is a small Chilean town on Navarino Island, on the south shore of the Beagle Channel. It is often called the southernmost town in the world, and it is the capital of the district that includes Cape Horn.
saint-jean-cap-ferrat-villefranche-sur-m: Villefranche-sur-Mer is on the French Riviera between Nice and Monaco. Its bay is one of the deepest natural harbours in the Mediterranean, which is why cruise ships often anchor here. The Cap Ferrat peninsula forms the far side of the bay.
ljubljana-be-igrad: Bežigrad is a district in the north of Ljubljana, the capital of Slovenia. The Slovenian Environment Agency has its headquarters and the city's main weather station here, and this is its camera.
